notes: an Authorization Scope states the bounds under which an attested agent may spend before any payment happens: the endorsed software identity the attestation must report, the per-payment and aggregate limits, the expiry, and optionally the executor, rails and payees
the plane is decision-input: the scope is authorization evidence available before the executor decides, and it asserts nothing about any payment that settled under it

the scope is a CBOR map in the deterministic encoding of RFC 8949 Section 4.2.1, and Section 3 computes the scope digest over exactly those bytes. Vaara ingests the decoded map, so this profile establishes the field mapping and never the scope digest; a digest recomputed from Vaara's JCS bytes would be a different value over a different encoding
apk and code.digest are CBOR byte strings, carried base64 in the decoded map this profile reads, and lifted verbatim without decoding or re-encoding

the scope carries no format identifier, so detection here is structural over the required members of the Section 3 CDDL. A scope registered as a Signed Statement is disambiguated by its payload type in the envelope, which is outside the decoded map

Section 3 makes executor REQUIRED when limits carries an aggregate bound, and a declarative detector cannot express a conditional requirement of that shape. A scope carrying aggregate with no executor is still recognized here, so recognition by this profile is not a conformance verdict on the scope

Section 4 Checks 1 to 4 are satisfied by transaction-time attestation evidence that is a separate artifact from this scope, so nothing here establishes that the key was never extractable, that the software matched, or that the evidence was fresh

this scope is the grant and carries nothing about settlement. The execution digest of Section 5.1 is computed over a settled payment's amount, payee, settlement timestamp and scope digest, and no member of it appears here

on_indeterminate selects the issuer's disposition when the supersession check of Check 9 cannot complete. Absent the member the disposition is refuse, and this profile lifts the member when present rather than asserting the default
evidence.sourceTitle: SCITT attested agent payment Authorization Scope (draft-hawkins-scitt-attested-agent-payment-01)
